tools_used: httpx and pypdf in-memory Supreme Court filing retrieval
helpful: Frozen band, distribution count, and snapshot date made the conditioning state explicit.
The petition appendix exposed the appellate court's factual analysis, allowing comparison with advocacy.
Unrounded statpack prefix fields supported an exact prior-Term pooled anchor.
The snapshot's exact opposition link allowed targeted pre-decision retrieval without opening the live docket.
gaps: The provisioned documents omitted the opposition submitted in the snapshot; direct retrieval recovered it.
Web tools returned empty responses; shell retrieval of the known public PDF and CourtListener MCP remained usable.
A response-request-conditioned cert base rate would improve calibration beyond the salience-band anchor.
notes: No case-outcome retrieval or corpus query was performed. The default uv cache was read-only; using a temporary cache allowed the CLI to run. No harness-owned context, process version, usage, or retrieval-log artifact was written.
